name: manual_aec976
claim: Review plaintext export and authority audit at their failure boundaries: an empty-file check is not atomic with replacement, and a failed post-write audit does not undo an authority mutation.

decisions.notes: Open review findings at Orama #534 a09c81eb and PT #526 24da09c1. Require race and failure-injection tests. Preserve fail-closed revocation and distinguish a process-scoped or shared development store from verified per-operator isolation. These findings do not assert a fix at those heads.
